<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <climits>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct Half {
    ll match;
    ll value;
    Half() : match(0), value(0) {}
    Half(ll m, ll v) : match(m), value(v) {}
    bool operator<(const Half& o) const {
        return value < o.value;
    }
};

class F1 {
public:
    vector<vector<ll>> ways;

    // Java-like shift for 64-bit: shift distance masked to 0-63
    static ll shiftLeft(ll x, int shift) {
        shift &= 63;
        return x << shift;
    }
    static ll shiftRight(ll x, int shift) {
        shift &= 63;
        return x >> shift;
    }

    static int trailingZeros(int x) {
        if (x == 0) return 32;
        return __builtin_ctz((unsigned int)x);
    }

    static int bitCount(int x) {
        return __builtin_popcount((unsigned int)x);
    }

    static bool test(int mask, int i) {
        return ((mask >> i) & 1) == 1;
    }

    bool nextCombination(vector<int>& a, int n) {
        int k = a.size();
        int ptr = k - 1;
        while (ptr >= 0 && a[ptr] == ptr - k + n) {
            ptr--;
        }
        if (ptr < 0) return false;
        a[ptr]++;
        for (int i = ptr + 1; i < k; i++) {
            a[i] = a[ptr] + i - ptr;
        }
        return true;
    }

    ll getWins(const vector<char>& s, int r, int c) {
        int curA = 0, curB = 0;
        ll ret = 0;
        for (char cc : s) {
            if (cc == 'A') {
                curA++;
            } else {
                ret += choose(curB, r - 1) * choose(curA, r);
                curB++;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }

    ll slow(int r, int c, const string& s) {
        vector<int> as(r + c);
        for (int i = 0; i < r + c; i++) as[i] = i;
        ll totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][c];
        vector<char> buf(2 * (r + c));
        ll bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
        ll ans = 0;
        vector<string> good;
        do {
            fill(buf.begin(), buf.end(), 'B');
            for (int pos : as) buf[pos] = 'A';
            int match = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); i++) {
                if (s[i] != '?' && s[i] != buf[i]) {
                    match = 0;
                    break;
                }
            }
            ll winsA = getWins(buf, r, c);
            ll diff = abs(2 * winsA - totalWays);
            if (diff < bestDiff) {
                bestDiff = diff;
                good.clear();
                if (match == 1) good.push_back(string(buf.begin(), buf.end()));
                ans = match;
            } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
                ans += match;
                if (match == 1) good.push_back(string(buf.begin(), buf.end()));
            }
        } while (nextCombination(as, 2 * (r + c)));
        return ans;
    }

    ll totalWays;
    ll bestDiff;
    ll ans;

    void update(const Half& a, const Half& b) {
        ll totalValue = a.value + b.value;
        ll diff = abs(2 * totalValue - totalWays);
        ll delta = a.match * b.match;
        if (diff < bestDiff) {
            bestDiff = diff;
            ans = delta;
        } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
            ans += delta;
        }
    }

    vector<Half> compress(vector<Half>& arr) {
        sort(arr.begin(), arr.end());
        int sz = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < (int)arr.size(); i++) {
            if (arr[i].value == arr[sz - 1].value) {
                arr[sz - 1].match += arr[i].match;
            } else {
                arr[sz++] = arr[i];
            }
        }
        arr.resize(sz);
        return arr;
    }

    ll choose(int n, int k) {
        if (n >= 0 && k >= 0 && k <= n) return ways[n][k];
        return 0;
    }

    ll solve(int r, int c, const string& s) {
        bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
        ans = 0;

        ll maskA = 0, maskB = 0;
        vector<vector<int>> cnt(s.length() + 1, vector<int>(2, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)s.length(); i++) {
            cnt[i + 1] = cnt[i];
            if (s[i] == 'A') {
                cnt[i + 1][0]++;
                maskA |= shiftLeft(1LL, i);
            }
            if (s[i] == 'B') {
                cnt[i + 1][1]++;
                maskB |= shiftLeft(1LL, i);
            }
        }

        ll lastA = shiftRight(maskA, 2 * r + c - 1);
        ll lastB = shiftRight(maskB, 2 * r + c - 1);

        int maxC = c + 2;
        vector<vector<Half>> fst(maxC), snd(maxC);
        vector<int> sz(maxC);
        for (int i = 0; i < maxC; i++) {
            sz[i] = (int)ways[c + 1][i];
            fst[i].resize(sz[i]);
            snd[i].resize(sz[i]);
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << (c + 1)); mask++) {
            int btc = bitCount(mask);
            int compBtc = c + 1 - btc;
            int idx = --sz[btc];

            // first half
            {
                int samePref = min(trailingZeros((mask & 1) == 0 ? mask : (mask + 1)), c + 1);
                int totalA = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][0];
                int totalB = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][1];
                if ((mask & 1) == 0) {
                    totalA += samePref;
                } else {
                    totalB += samePref;
                }

                ll winsA = 0;
                int curA = 0, curB = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
                    if (test(mask, i)) {
                        winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA, r);
                        curB++;
                    } else {
                        curA++;
                    }
                }

                int exactMatch = 1;
                for (int i = samePref; i < c + 1; i++) {
                    if (!test(mask, i) && s[2 * r - 2 + i] == 'B') {
                        exactMatch = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                    if (test(mask, i) && s[2 * r - 2 + i] == 'A') {
                        exactMatch = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                fst[btc][idx] = Half(choose(totalA + totalB, totalA) * exactMatch, winsA);
            }

            // second half
            {
                int match = 1;
                if ((~mask & lastB) != 0) match = 0;
                if ((mask & lastA) != 0) match = 0;

                ll winsA = 0;
                int curA = btc, curB = compBtc;
                for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
                    if (test(mask, i)) {
                        winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA, r);
                        curB++;
                    } else {
                        curA++;
                    }
                }

                snd[btc][idx] = Half(match, winsA);
            }
        }

        totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][r];
        ll halfTotal = totalWays / 2;

        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            vector<Half> one = compress(fst[i]);
            vector<Half> two = compress(snd[c + 1 - i]);

            int ptr = (int)two.size() - 1;
            for (const Half& a : one) {
                while (ptr >= 0 && a.value + two[ptr].value > halfTotal) {
                    ptr--;
                }
                if (ptr >= 0) {
                    update(a, two[ptr]);
                }
                if (ptr + 1 < (int)two.size()) {
                    update(a, two[ptr + 1]);
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    void submit() {
        int r, c;
        cin >> r >> c;
        string s;
        cin >> s;
        cout << solve(r, c, s) << endl;
    }

    void preCalc() {
        ways.assign(61, vector<ll>());
        for (int i = 0; i < 61; i++) {
            ways[i].resize(i + 1);
            ways[i][0] = ways[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                ways[i][j] = ways[i - 1][j - 1] + ways[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    void stress() {
        srand(time(0));
        for (int tst = 0;; tst++) {
            int r = rand() % 3 + 1;
            int c = rand() % 3 + 1;
            string buf(2 * (r + c), '?');
            ll fast = solve(r, c, buf);
            ll slow = this->slow(r, c, buf);
            if (fast != slow) {
                cerr << r << " " << c << " " << buf << endl;
                cerr << fast << endl;
                cerr << slow << endl;
                throw logic_error("Mismatch");
            }
            cerr << tst << " passed" << endl;
        }
    }

    void test() {
        int r = 1, c = 3;
        string s = "ABBAABBA";
        cerr << solve(r, c, s) << endl;
    }

    F1() {
        preCalc();
        submit();
        // stress();
        // test();
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    F1 f;
    return 0;
}
